# Reflextry — Complete AI Context

> Reflextry is a free, browser-based brain training and human benchmark platform. It offers 45+ scientifically-inspired cognitive tests and games spanning reaction time, memory, typing speed, accuracy, and FPS aim training. No login required. Instant play. Designed for Gen Z gamers, students, and anyone wanting to measure and improve their cognitive performance.

Website: https://www.reflextry.com
Sitemap: https://www.reflextry.com/sitemap.xml
LLMs.txt: https://www.reflextry.com/llms.txt

## What Reflextry Does

Reflextry is the modern alternative to Human Benchmark. It provides free, high-quality cognitive tests across five core categories:

1. **Reflex** — Visual and auditory reaction time tests, peripheral vision, multi-stimulus processing
2. **Memory** — Sequence memory, number memory, visual memory, chimp test, verbal memory, card matching
3. **Speed** — CPS (clicks per second), typing speed (WPM), mental math, word accuracy, number rush
4. **Accuracy** — Precision clicking, pattern matching, data entry, color matching, mental rotation, color blindness screening
5. **Gaming** — Aim trainer, flick shot trainer, target tracking, endless dodge, rhythm tap, stroop drop

All tests track scores, show percentile rankings, and provide instant results with no account required.

---

## Reflex Tests (10 tests)

### Reaction Time Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/reaction
- **What it measures**: Visual reaction time in milliseconds
- **How it works**: The screen turns green after a random delay. Click as fast as you can. Measures the time between the color change and your click.
- **Key terms**: reaction time test, human benchmark reaction time, click reaction test, visual reaction time test, reflex test, test my reflexes, reaction speed test

### Audio Reaction Time Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/sound
- **What it measures**: Auditory reaction speed in milliseconds
- **How it works**: Listen for a beep sound and click as fast as possible when you hear it. Tests hearing-based reflexes.
- **Key terms**: audio reaction time test, sound reflex test, hearing reaction time, auditory reaction test

### Grid Shot — FPS Aim Trainer
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/grid
- **What it measures**: Mouse accuracy, click precision, and target acquisition speed
- **How it works**: Targets appear on a grid. Click them as fast and accurately as possible. Essential aim training for FPS gamers.
- **Key terms**: grid shot, aim grid test, grid click reaction, reflex grid game

### Peripheral Vision Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/peripheral
- **What it measures**: Wide-field visual awareness and side vision reaction time
- **How it works**: Spot and click targets that appear in your peripheral vision while focusing on the center.
- **Key terms**: peripheral vision test, peripheral awareness test, visual field test, side vision test

### Directional Reflex Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/direction
- **What it measures**: Decision-making speed and keyboard reaction time
- **How it works**: An arrow appears on screen. Press the matching arrow key as fast as possible.
- **Key terms**: directional reflex test, arrow reaction test, keyboard direction reflex

### Multi-Stimulus Reaction Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/multi-stimulus
- **What it measures**: Selective attention and choice reaction time
- **How it works**: Multiple stimuli appear simultaneously. React only to the correct one. Tests complex cognitive processing.
- **Key terms**: multi-stimulus reaction test, choice reaction time test, selective attention test

### Sequence Reaction Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/sequence-reaction
- **What it measures**: Working memory combined with reaction speed
- **How it works**: Watch a sequence of flashing lights, then click them in the same order as fast as possible.
- **Key terms**: sequence reaction test, pattern reflex test, memory and reaction test

### Whack-a-Mole Reflex Game
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/whack-a-mole
- **What it measures**: Reaction speed and hand-eye coordination
- **How it works**: Moles pop up from holes at increasing speed. Tap them before they disappear.
- **Key terms**: whack a mole online, whack a mole reaction test, click the mole game

### Color Switch Reflex Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/color-switch
- **What it measures**: Cognitive reflexes and selective attention
- **How it works**: React to specific color flashes while ignoring others. Trains mental processing speed.
- **Key terms**: color switch reaction test, color change reflex test, traffic light reaction time

### Time Perception Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/reflex/time-perception
- **What it measures**: Internal clock accuracy and time estimation ability
- **How it works**: Hold a button for exactly the target number of seconds without looking at a clock.
- **Key terms**: time perception test, internal clock test, time estimation test, human benchmark time perception

## Memory Tests (11 tests)

### Sequence Memory Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/sequence
- **What it measures**: Working memory and sequence recall capacity
- **How it works**: A sequence of tiles lights up. Repeat the pattern. The sequence grows longer each round.
- **Key terms**: sequence memory test, human benchmark sequence memory, simon says memory game, pattern sequence test

### Number Memory Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/number
- **What it measures**: Digit span and numeric working memory
- **How it works**: A number flashes on screen. Type it back from memory. Numbers get longer each round.
- **Key terms**: number memory test, digit span test, human benchmark number memory, number recall test

### Visual Memory Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/visual
- **What it measures**: Spatial awareness and visual short-term memory
- **How it works**: A grid pattern flashes briefly. Click the squares that were highlighted. Grids grow larger each round.
- **Key terms**: visual memory test, human benchmark visual memory, spatial memory test, photographic memory test

### Stroop Effect Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/color
- **What it measures**: Cognitive flexibility and attention
- **How it works**: Color words are displayed in mismatched ink colors. Identify the ink color, not the word.
- **Key terms**: stroop test, stroop effect test, cognitive flexibility test, color word test

### Shape Rush
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/shape
- **What it measures**: Visual discrimination and processing speed
- **How it works**: Find the target shape among distractors as fast as possible. Shapes get more similar over time.
- **Key terms**: shape memory test, visual processing speed, shape matching game

### Symbol Pairs Memory Game
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/symbol
- **What it measures**: Concentration and visual spatial memory
- **How it works**: Flip cards to find matching symbol pairs. Complete the board in as few moves as possible.
- **Key terms**: symbol memory test, memory match game, card concentration game

### Word Recall Memory Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/word-recall
- **What it measures**: Verbal memory and cognitive recall
- **How it works**: Study a list of words, then recall as many as possible from memory.
- **Key terms**: word recall test, word memory test, verbal memory training, list learning test

### Card Match Memory Game
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/card-match
- **What it measures**: Pattern recognition and spatial memory
- **How it works**: Classic pairs-matching card game. Flip two cards at a time to find all matching pairs.
- **Key terms**: card match memory game, memory card game online, flip card memory game

### Chimp Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/chimp-test
- **What it measures**: Working memory (based on the famous Ayumu chimpanzee experiment)
- **How it works**: Numbers appear briefly on screen, then are hidden. Click their positions in ascending order.
- **Key terms**: chimp test, chimp test human benchmark, chimpanzee memory test, are you smarter than a chimp

### Verbal Memory Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/verbal-memory
- **What it measures**: Verbal recognition memory
- **How it works**: Words are shown one at a time. Mark each word as "Seen" or "New." The test tracks how many you get right.
- **Key terms**: verbal memory test, verbal memory human benchmark, word recognition test

### Multiple Object Tracking Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/memory/object-tracking
- **What it measures**: Visual attention and tracking ability
- **How it works**: Several objects move around the screen. Track the highlighted targets among identical distractors.
- **Key terms**: multiple object tracking test, object tracking test, visual tracking test

---

## Speed Tests (7 tests)

### CPS Test — Clicks Per Second
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/click
- **What it measures**: Mouse clicking speed (CPS)
- **How it works**: Click as fast as possible within a time limit. Supports jitter clicking, butterfly clicking, and drag clicking techniques.
- **Key terms**: cps test, clicks per second, click speed test, jitter click test, kohi click test, mouse clicking speed

### Typing Speed Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/typing
- **What it measures**: Typing speed (WPM) and accuracy
- **How it works**: Type a passage of text as quickly and accurately as possible. Measures words per minute and error rate.
- **Key terms**: typing speed test, wpm test, words per minute test, typing test online, keyboard speed test

### Speed Math Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/math
- **What it measures**: Mental arithmetic speed and calculation fluency
- **How it works**: Solve basic math problems (addition, subtraction, multiplication) as fast as possible.
- **Key terms**: speed math test, mental math game, arithmetic speed test, fast math, calculation speed

### Word Accuracy Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/words
- **What it measures**: Typing precision and error rate
- **How it works**: Type exact words as they appear. Measures accuracy percentage and speed.
- **Key terms**: word accuracy test, precision typing, typing accuracy, word speed test

### Grid Selection Speed Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/grid
- **What it measures**: Visual search speed and mouse accuracy
- **How it works**: Find and click highlighted cells in a grid as fast as possible.
- **Key terms**: grid speed test, visual search test, grid selection, schulte table test

### Number Rush Speed Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/number-rush
- **What it measures**: Visual scanning speed and sequential attention
- **How it works**: Numbers are scattered on screen. Click them in ascending order (1, 2, 3…) as fast as possible.
- **Key terms**: number rush game, 1 to 50 number game, tap the numbers speed test, number speed clicking

### Quick Sort Speed Game
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/speed/quick-sort
- **What it measures**: Cognitive processing and categorization speed
- **How it works**: Items appear on screen. Sort them into the correct categories before time runs out.
- **Key terms**: quick sort speed test, speed categorization test, cognitive sorting test, rapid sorting game

---

## Accuracy Tests (8 tests)

### Precision Clicking Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/precision-click
- **What it measures**: Hand-eye coordination and fine motor control
- **How it works**: Small targets appear on screen. Click them as accurately as possible. Measures hit rate and average distance from center.
- **Key terms**: precision click test, mouse precision test, mouse accuracy test, hand-eye coordination test

### Pattern Matching Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/pattern-matching
- **What it measures**: Visual precision and attention to detail
- **How it works**: Two complex patterns are shown. Determine if they match or differ.
- **Key terms**: pattern matching test, visual pattern recognition, cognitive pattern matching

### Data Entry Accuracy Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/data
- **What it measures**: Data entry precision and keystroke accuracy
- **How it works**: Type complex alphanumeric codes exactly as displayed. Measures accuracy percentage and KPH.
- **Key terms**: data entry test, data entry speed test, alphanumeric data entry, keystroke accuracy test

### Image Recognition Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/image-recognition
- **What it measures**: Visual accuracy and observation skills
- **How it works**: Spot differences between images or identify matching images from a set.
- **Key terms**: image recognition test, spot the difference test, visual recognition game

### Angle Estimation Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/angle-estimation
- **What it measures**: Spatial awareness and visual estimation precision
- **How it works**: An angle is shown. Estimate its degree value as accurately as possible.
- **Key terms**: angle estimation test, guess the angle game, visual angle test, spatial reasoning test

### Color Match Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/color-match
- **What it measures**: Color discrimination and visual accuracy
- **How it works**: Match exact color shades from a palette. Tests how precisely you can distinguish similar colors.
- **Key terms**: color match test, hue matching test, color accuracy test, shade matching game

### Color Blindness Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/color-blindness
- **What it measures**: Color vision deficiency screening
- **How it works**: Ishihara-style dot plates with hidden numbers. Identify the numbers to screen for color blindness.
- **Key terms**: color blindness test, ishihara test, color blind test, am i color blind, color vision test

### Mental Rotation Test
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/accuracy/mental-rotation
- **What it measures**: Spatial intelligence and 3D visualization ability
- **How it works**: Two 3D objects are shown at different rotations. Determine if they are the same shape or mirror images.
- **Key terms**: mental rotation test, spatial reasoning test, 3d shape rotation test, spatial intelligence test

---

## Gaming & Aim Training (7 tests)

### Aim Trainer Pro
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/aim
- **What it measures**: Mouse tracking, flicking accuracy, and precision for FPS games
- **How it works**: Moving targets appear on screen. Track and click them. Trains tracking aim, flick aim, and precision.
- **Key terms**: aim trainer, aim trainer online, free aim trainer, fps aim practice, mouse aim test, valorant aim trainer

### RPG Reaction — Block & Parry
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/reaction
- **What it measures**: Timing and defensive reflexes
- **How it works**: An enemy attacks. Press the block button at the right moment. Tests RPG-style combat timing.
- **Key terms**: rpg reaction test, qte reaction game, gaming reflex test, block and parry

### Endless Dodge
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/endless-dodge
- **What it measures**: Evasion reflexes and spatial awareness
- **How it works**: Dodge incoming projectiles for as long as possible. Speed and density increase over time.
- **Key terms**: endless dodge game, dodge reaction test, bullet hell dodge, survival dodge test

### Infinite Stroop Drop
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/stroop-drop
- **What it measures**: Impulse control and cognitive reflection
- **How it works**: Color words fall down the screen. Click the button matching the font color (not the word). Based on the Stroop effect.
- **Key terms**: stroop drop game, stroop effect test, cognitive stroop game, brain training stroop

### Target Tracking
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/target-tracking
- **What it measures**: Continuous aim accuracy and mouse tracking precision
- **How it works**: A target moves erratically. Keep your cursor on it as long as possible.
- **Key terms**: target tracking test, moving target aim test, fps tracking trainer, mouse tracking test

### Flick Shot Aim Trainer
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/flick-shot
- **What it measures**: Flicking accuracy and muscle memory
- **How it works**: Targets appear at random positions. Flick your mouse to them and click as fast as possible.
- **Key terms**: flick shot aim trainer, flick shot test, flick aim practice, fps flick trainer

### Rhythm Tap Game
- **URL**: https://www.reflextry.com/gaming/rhythm-tap
- **What it measures**: Rhythmic timing and audio-visual coordination
- **How it works**: Tap to the beat of the music. Tests how accurately you can maintain rhythm.
- **Key terms**: rhythm tap game, rhythm reaction test, tap the beat game, music rhythm test
